entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE determines which frequencies are part of MBS frequencies of interest based on specific conditions.

entities.name: MBS frequencies of interest
entities.description: Set of frequencies considered by the UE for MBS reception based on defined conditions.

entities.name: MBS session ongoing or about to start
entities.description: At least one MBS session the UE is receiving or interested to receive via broadcast MRB is ongoing or about to start.

entities.name: SIB21 includes MBS FSAI for frequency
entities.description: For at least one MBS session, SIB21 acquired from PCell includes for the concerned frequency one or more MBS FSAIs as indicated in USD for this session.

entities.name: UE supports band combination
entities.description: The supportedBandCombination in UE-NR-Capability contains at least one band combination including the set of MBS frequencies of interest.

entities.name: MBS session
entities.description: Multicast/broadcast service session that UE is receiving or interested to receive via broadcast MRB.

entities.name: System Information Block 21
entities.description: SIB containing MBS frequency-specific assistance information (FSAI) for MBS sessions.

relations.description: UE determines MBS frequencies of interest based on meeting all conditions.
Frequency is part of MBS frequencies of interest if MBS session is ongoing or about to start.
Frequency is part of MBS frequencies of interest if SIB21 includes MBS FSAI for that frequency.
Frequency is part of MBS frequencies of interest if UE supports band combination including these frequencies.
Condition requires at least one MBS session to be ongoing or about to start.
Condition requires SIB21 to include MBS FSAI for the concerned frequency.
Condition requires UE-NR-Capability to contain supported band combination including MBS frequencies of interest.
